title: Unit Event — Competitive Fire!

meta.Outline: When Vivid BAD SQUAD go for a meal with Ken, Taiga and the twins before their return to Japan, an unexpected reunion sparks a newfound fire in An.

rows.Line: New York
Hotel - Cafe Entrance

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Over here, you two!
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry, did we keep you waiting?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, we just came down from our rooms a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get some food—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Wait, where are the twins?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Cedric and Slade messaged us just now to say they'd be a little late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Apparently, they ran into some people they know on the way over here...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh? Pretty bold of them to keep me waiting like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're always late for everything, Uncle Taiga, so I think it's only fair that you should have to wait for people every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Fortunately, we still have some time until our reservation. Let's just wait patiently for them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad we get to have one last meal together, since we're heading back to Japan tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, Ken, Taiga, aren't either of you feeling tired from yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you two are just coming off an incredible performance.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hah! Not a chance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's unbelievable...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Less than a day after being a part of such an amazing event...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It probably helps that they're used to that kinda thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we sorta felt the same way after RAD BLAST, didn't we? We were all beat, but emotionally we were on cloud nine!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were only part of the audience yesterday, but my heart never stopped racing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It was like my whole chest had caught fire!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My chest still feels really warm.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm so excited that I can't really stay still...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we decided to visit the United States.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, getting to see a world-class event right up close is one thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But we also have a new goal now.
To win RUSH BEATS!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Getting a firm idea of what standing on top of the world actually means is a major development for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still got plenty of obstacles in front of us, of course.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. RUSH BEATS is a tournament, and the outcome certainly won't be decided in one day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While it happens, we'll likely be going back and forth between Japan and the US. Performing abroad means needing to secure travel funds and places to stay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
There's probably a whole list of other things we need to think about as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, probably...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: In any case, good luck with everything.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We started this fire, so feel free to ask us for advice.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, your first step is to give things a go yourselves. You'd be surprised how often things just work out if you throw enough effort at it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And while you're out there blazing your own trail, you're getting stronger along the way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, okay!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you're going to participate in RUSH BEATS, then you might end up facing them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Them?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, they're about the same age as all of you...
Thanks for waiting, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Look at that, sounds like the twins decided to grace us with their presence.
se_run_men_002_1
se_run_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Sorry we're late!
You guys have probably been waiting for a while, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's okay! You ran into some people you know along the way, right?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. We mentioned we'd be eating with Taiga and Ken, and they insisted on coming to say hi since it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, do you mean...?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Hiya! Sorry to barge in on you!
We just wanted to... Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Wait, you're the guys from yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: What are you all doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Wait a minute, are you Vivid BAD SQUAD?!?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's going on here?
Several dozen minutes later
Restaurant

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, cheers!

rows.Speaker: Slade & Elena
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Ceddy and Slade told us that everyone from Vivid BAD SQUAD would also be here...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: But are you sure about us joining all of you like this? I feel kind of bad...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! The more the merrier, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But I still can't believe it.
I didn't know you two knew my dad and Uncle Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We initially began as fans of RADder.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of RADder?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: That's right! We saw the three of them sing when we were little, and were totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Like, “kaboom”! Oh, in Japanese, that'd be...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Kaboom”... Like an explosion or lightning strike.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, so they hit you really hard?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yeah, the impact was huge!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: And their music was just so different to what we'd heard before.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: That was also how we ended up meeting Slade and Ceddy.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We actually got song lessons from RADder themselves with the boys from time to time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: But we started learning first.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Which means you two are our juniors. What's the word? “Imoto-dashi”...?

rows.Speaker: Cedric & Rebecca
rows.Line: You mean “imoto-deshi.”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Yeah, that!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How'd you land on “imoto-dashi”?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Seriously, it's always so loud when you four are around.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Good to see that not much has changed since then.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: By the way, Elena, Rebecca...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You two are participating in RUSH BEATS, right?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Of course we are!
After all, our goal is to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: I knew it! That makes us all rivals.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD's entering too, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! There's no way we're passing up this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yes! We finally get to face off against the fabled An that Ken and his team told us all about!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Kind of a little embarrassing when you put it that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that means I especially can't lose!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you say, but we haven't even applied yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We did just hear about RUSH BEATS yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Then, does that mean you don't know all the details yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
We did take a quick look at the tournament website, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We don't actually know what the rules are, or the tournament's format for that matter.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Alright, in simple terms...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: RUSH BEATS began as an event that was put together by people from around these parts who love street music, for similar-minded people.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Then, it grew and grew into a festival where thousands come to watch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thousands...? That's pretty big for an event for “similar-minded people”.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. And just last year, they got a big-name sponsor on board.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Now, it involves prize money, it's broadcast on TV and the internet...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: And winning gives you a chance to perform at Lasting ECHO Fest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: But because it has so many entrants now, most don't make it past the prelims.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Only the top eight teams are allowed to advance to the actual stage.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yeah, it has gotten bigger, but the most basic rule hasn't changed.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: The team that gets the audience going the most wins!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The team that gets the audience going the most...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, okay. That's easy enough to understand!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I like that better than some big list of complicated rules.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Oh, you all sound pretty confident.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Not quite...
More like we're used to that sort of simplicity.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It didn't matter if we were singing on Vivid Street or at the live houses we trained with...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In the end, all it came down to was how much we could excite the people who came to listen.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright then...
I'm looking forward to seeing who comes out on top.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can't wait... Tt's gonna be such an awesome event!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Who knows what's gonna happen if we end up facing off during the knockout stage...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I don't think I've heard Cedric sing yet. Only Slade sang that other time.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Plus, Elena and Becky are both amazing, but I think they were just playing around that time...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I doubt we've seen their full power yet.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna know what they all really sound like...
Outside the restaurant

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright, we're out.
Got a meeting with our record company.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We'll drive you all over to the airport tomorrow, so rest up until then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much for today.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Make sure to come hear us sing next time, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, if we feel like it.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what do you guys wanna do now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, we don't have anything scheduled...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Really? Then, wanna keep strolling around for a bit more?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: You're all heading back to Japan tomorrow, right? Since you're here, we should hang out at least a little more!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, good point!
I do wanna look around a bit more before heading back.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Hanging out is fine and all, but did you have any places in mind?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Leave it to us! After all, this is basically our backyard.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: So, come take a trip on the Special Manhattan Course!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Special Manhattan Course...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess let's follow them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, awesome! There's a ton of people singing here...!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: This is an avenue where street musicians like to gather!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: You'll want to keep an eye on that team singing on that corner. They're pretty legit, and word is they're definitely going to sign up for RUSH BEATS.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The other teams also sound pretty good.
Wanna listen to them for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: This shop carries all sorts of super rare music goods. You guys come here pretty often, right, Slade?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Yeah! We can't get enough of this place because they have so many hidden gems.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really...?
Oh, hey! Isn't this shirt from a LAST DAYS concert?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
And it's signed by every member...!
Where in the world did they get this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: C-Can I take a picture...?!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Even among professional musicians, this studio's super duper ludicrously popular!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? This building looks kinda familiar somehow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place appears in quite a lot of films, so that may be why.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's the thing.
So many people dream of coming here.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Becky and I are always talking about recording music here someday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You two must genuinely love music!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All the places you've shown us have been connected to music in some way.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah!
We basically spend each day singing or listening to music.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: It's been that way since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: But RADder is the main reason we got so obsessed.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We probably wouldn't take it so seriously if we hadn't met those three.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, we've just been taking you guys around to all our favorite spots.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Are there any things that you guys wanna do? This is your last chance to enjoy what the United States of America has to offer!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our last chance?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not much comes to mind...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, in that case...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's sing! I wanna hear what illys and Embers really sound like!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: You wanna hear us sing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We're all gonna be rivals at RUSH BEATS, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's all get a sense of what we can do. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd also like to hear you all sing...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same...
We still haven't had a chance to hear you guys sing as teams.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Alright, let's do it!
We've still only had a chance to hear Kohane sing!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Then, which team should go first?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Wait, we shouldn't sing here. We don't want to block the way for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good point. We should try to find somewhere a little more spacious.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What about the place where Elena and Becky sang yesterday...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Since we're here, why not go to a live house?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A live house... Is there one that'll just let us waltz in?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: There's a place which does open-mic events that's just a short walk from here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Open-mic events...?
So anyone's allowed to perform, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it doesn't matter if you're a professional or an amateur. Everybody is free to sing and perform in front of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're supposed to be very common outside of Japan.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? Then, let's go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Okay! It's this way!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can't wait to hear the way they all sing.)
<An. An.>

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Line:
<Each team is going to sing, right?

Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, would you mind telling us later if we sounded funny to you?

rows.Speaker: Luka

rows.Line: <But still...>

rows.Line: <You seem really happy, An.>

rows.Line: Geez, don't scare us like that...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Each team will get ten minutes, so I'd say aim for about two songs per.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
We're going last, huh...
But I wanna sing now!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: You were the one who said we should decide by playing rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Hehe. And we get to go first!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We should get closer to the front so that we can see everyone perform.

se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Line: Okay! Hm...?

rows.Line: Is something wrong, An?

rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Line: “I'm sorry! Uhh...”

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: That's not the issue here.

rows.Line: Don't go anywhere near this guy, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Line: H-He's speaking Japanese...?

rows.Line: What are you doing here?

Some minor business.
The owner and I go a long way back.

rows.Line: Hey, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Did something happen?
The atmosphere's gotten very tense...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: “Douglas?”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “No way...!”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “Wh-What's DG doing here?!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: DG?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: The legendary street musician!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: He started out as a nobody with one microphone, and now he's a big-time producer with his name all over the industry.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: He doesn't appear in the media a lot, but his music's got a pretty serious following.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: “Legendary” might be a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: But I am happy that young musicians such as yourselves know about me.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Are you friends of my daughters?

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Line:
I'm Slade and this is Cedric...
We're in a team called Embers.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We're friends of Elena and Becky.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Oh, you guys are Embers?

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Rumor has it that you're one of the hottest young groups out there. It's an honor to meet you two.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Likewise.
We didn't think that someone like you would know who we are, DG.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Anyway, these four are...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD...

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Good team name. I'll be sure to remember it.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Are you done...?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: I'll apologize for losing my temper a bit back there.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But we don't want anything to do with you now.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line:
I know.
Believe me, I don't want to be babysitting you forever either.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making things so awkward for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: I hope we meet again someday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uhh... Thank you!
